excavate.label: Excavating a vault dig site
excavate.explanation: A level-12 Druid with Stone to Mud digs a quartz grid beside a permanent vault wall. The original clears the grid's glow flag and then sets the glow again under a comment reading "Dark" — the freshly dug grid is remembered as glowing. The correction sets the dark flag as the comment says.

SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP vault=1 spelllegal=1 wallfeat=18 perma_adjacent=1
SETUP seed=1000 class=Druid level=13 depth=30 mana=72/72
  excavated_grid_marked_dark  MODE excavate
DECISION acted=1 keys=9 sequence=* p 3 6 5 m b c 5
STATE glow=1 dark=0
OUTCOME acted=1 dark_marked=0
Failed
    native-c/excavate-236:168: requirement 'dark == 1' failed

no-target.label: Control: no dig site beside a permanent wall
no-target.explanation: With no excavatable grid adjacent to a permanent wall the routine finds nothing and no flags are touched. The complete logs are byte-identical.
